### True Happiness
Author: Joe Holland
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/true-happiness
Passage: Psalm 32:1
Points:
- Chasing worldly success traps people in an endless cycle of dissatisfaction.
- Scripture reveals that true blessing can be fully experienced in the present life.
- Lasting joy depends on whether God has pardoned our guilt, not on earthly circumstances.
- Forgiveness cannot be earned through good works; it is a gift freely given by God.
- Believers anchor their happiness in Jesus’ finished atonement on the cross.

### Surrounded By Mercy
Author: David C. McCasland
Site: Our Daily Bread
URL: https://military.odb.org/surrounded-by-mercy/
Passage: Psalm 32:10
Points:
- Stubbornness often prevents people from seeking help for both physical and spiritual sickness.
- Hiding guilt causes suffering, whereas confessing sin brings joyful release.
- God wants to guide His people gently rather than having to restrain them like stubborn animals.
- Experiencing pardon begins with humbly admitting our need for God's grace.
- Those who place their trust in the Lord are encircled by His steadfast mercy.
